entities.summary: Max Black was a Russian-born British-American philosopher who was a leading figure in analytic philosophy in the years after World War II. He made contributions to the philosophy of language, the philosophy of mathematics and science, and the philosophy of art, also publishing studies of the work of philosophers such as Frege. His translation of Frege's published philosophical writing is a classic text. Max Black was a writers & intellectuals from Baku (1909-02-24, Baku–1988-08-27). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
